office: the Civil Status Division (National Identity Card Unit)

routes.label: at a Civil Status Division office

note: The Civil Status Division's presentation to ID4Africa (June 2019): citizens are required by law to apply for the National Identity Card at 18, and its first issue at 18 or above is free of charge. Renewal and replacement fees, the card's term and the time weren't found in what could be read.

sources.title: Civil Status Division (Mauritius), The CVRS and Identity Eco System in the Civil Status Office, ID4Africa 2019 (18-21 June 2019)
sources.said: At the age of 18 or above: ... First issue-Free of Charge ... All citizens are required by law to apply for their National Identity Card at the age of 18.
